title: Manager – Marketing, Executive Education (on Contract)
summary: IIM Udaipur is inviting applications for the position of Manager – Marketing, Executive Education on a two-year contractual basis. The role involves leading marketing strategies, managing digital campaigns, and supporting business development for executive education programs.
eligibility_bullets: Postgraduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university.
MBA in Marketing or PG degree in Mass Communication/Journalism/PR preferred.
Minimum 8 years of experience in marketing (brand, digital, social media, content, events, or B2B).
Hands-on experience in planning and executing marketing campaigns.
Proficiency in digital marketing tools (LinkedIn, Google, Meta Ads, SEO, Analytics) and design software (Canva, Adobe).
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official IIM Udaipur website at www.iimu.ac.in.
Complete the online application form as per the instructions provided.
